title: grpo-state (code phase): GRPO in the proof-state environment

title: lit-measures: state base's one bad step, identical-seed rerun noise, mode shares by EI round
model: M1 SN base s0 / SN EI s0 (cap 6); M2 72 Stage-1 lean_seq models; M3 111 existing ladders
protocol: M1 teacher-forced log p T0.8 and T1.0; M2 8x8 init x data-order grid + 8 identical-seed reruns; M3 found files
headline: M1: SN EI's 7 new-theorem proofs have median worst step -14.71 nats under the base (13 below controls, p 0.0002); M2: data order explains ~0.02 of depth-3 variance, identical-seed reruns span 0.22-0.90 (~half the variance); M3 round3-run4b per-round counts not supported (start-index duplicates).

title: long-pool-2: pool past L_true 17 and SN-cap12 T1 fall-off
model: SN-cap12 T1/frozen s0-s3, K12 whole-proof T1 s0-s1, SN-v2 cap-6 T1 s0-s1
protocol: 91 theorems (61 exact-17, 30 >=18) pass@256 T0.8 seed 0, max_steps 96
headline: Only 21 new L>=17 theorems (consecutive chunk seeds wasted ~69% of rows); SN-cap12 T1 solves 34/59/58/61 of 91; exact-17 minus >=18 +7.3 pp (CI [-7.7,+22.6], MDD ~30 pp): no fall-off detected.

title: search-expert: best-first search as the EI expert vs sampling
model: SN-cap12 s0-s5 + 8 EI rounds per arm (A sampling, B best-first, A2, C truncate-resume)
protocol: Q291 pass@256 T0.8 seed 0, read without search; 6 paired seeds (A2, C 2 seeds)
headline: Best-first expert spends ~23% of sampling's actions and finds 0.33x its new targets; apprentice ties: B - A = -1.3 of 291 (CI [-7.1,+4.5]); state-cap12 T1 recipe beats A by 63-96 (cause unidentified; 'selection rule matters most' not supported).

title: trajectory: when does the eventual proof become likely (best-cap12)
model: best-cap12 fresh s0-s2: 14 Stage-1 ckpts + T1 r1-r8 (66 ckpts)
protocol: textbook72 + holdout250 (322) pass@256 T0.8 sample seeds x0 (groups) and x1 (pass@k) at all 22 ckpts; teacher-forced worst-step log p T1.0
headline: For RL-only theorems (B) the eventual proof's worst step rises +4.1 nats (IQM) from step 1,600 to end of pretraining and +4.6 in RL: 'mainly in RL' not resolved at n=3; RL lifts B's known reference proofs +1.55; C references stay near -9 nats.

title: compute-match: our 3.2M ladder given best-cap12's ladder GPU time (k 64)

headline: At 1.02x best12's ladder A40-seconds (1.82x attempts), best12 still beats cm12 by +15.7 textbook72 (52/51/52 vs 36/36/36) and +87.3 dev; doubling k moved nothing beyond noise (textbook72 paired 0/-4/0).

title: rl-from-ckpt: T1 ladders from earlier Stage-1 checkpoints with replay-only controls
model: trajectory's best-cap12 s0-s2; ladders from p0/p1600/p5000/p12000/p16000/pend + replay-only controls
protocol: textbook72 + holdout250 pass@256 T0.8, sample seed x1 at r8 (x0 also); threshold test on reference worst-step log p
headline: Ladders from step >=5,000 end level with the end arm (textbook72 46.0-49.0 vs 49.7); from step 1,600 13 short; from step 0 nothing accepted; pre-registered creation test not decisive; post hoc calibrated and selection-free reach show no early start beyond the end arm (consistent with elicitation once replay counts as pretraining).

title: trajectory-cap6: the trajectory analysis on best-cap6
model: best-cap6 fresh s0-s2: 14 Stage-1 ckpts + T1 r1-r8; best-cap12 (trajectory) as comparison
protocol: textbook72 + holdout250 (322) pass@256 T0.8 x0/x1 at 22 ckpts; teacher-forced worst-step log p T1.0; cross-seed and cap-12 proofs scored
headline: At cap 6 B's worst step climbs mainly in RL: Delta_RL +8.8 vs Delta_PT +2.2 nats (3/3 seeds, IQM diff 6.6 >= 2-nat MDD), also on selection-free targets (references +5.1 vs +1.5); at cap 12 the two were ~equal.
